Contracts: Aug 4 – Aug 31, 2026  ·  Fund by: Sep 14, 2026
Dealer Flat & Reserve
K500 flat, T1–3: Premier $200 / VIP $150 / Partner $100
K500 flat, T4–8: Premier $150 / VIP $100 / Partner $50
K506: 1% mark-up —or— flat up to $450

73–84 months: K500 tier 1/2 only. K506 stops at 72 months — a dash means the term is not offered, not a 0% rate.
